messages.content: Plan solely from current memory and the fictional offer catalog. All hard constraints must hold. If budget allows, prefer comfortable morning flights and the resort; use cheaper compliant alternatives when needed. Include one accessible beach visit and one seated food activity on separate days if feasible. Costs in the catalog already cover the stated two-person trip; add fixed costs once. If no supplied hotel fits, pause, leave supplier IDs null and total null. Return only JSON {"decision":"plan" or "pause", "flight_id":string or null, "hotel_id":string or null, "activity_ids":[string], "activity_days":{activity_id:"YYYY-MM-DD"}, "total_inr":number or null, "budget_inr":number, "max_walk_metres":number, "reasons":[string], "evidence_claim_ids":[string]}.
